meaning:
§ Jazer or Jaazer = "helped"
a Levitical city east of the Jordan, in Gilead in the territory of Gad, formerly an Amorite city; site uncertain

elsewhere.note: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;
They passed over the Jordan, and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and to Jazer;
Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.
